caption:
How to do it yourself, step by step.

1. Open The Gear Equalizer on aluxartandframes.shop
2. Crop your photo to 4:5, then upload it
3. Type 197 in the search box — it picks the look for you
4. Leave the background alone
5. Pay ₦1,000 and download it

The look is "197 · S Night Paparazzi G7X". You do not have to remember the name — the number is enough.

Works on any photo you already have. Dark club, dim restaurant, bad hall lighting, night shots on your phone.

slides.title: How this was done.
slides.body: Five steps. Two minutes. The photo already existed.

slides.title: 1. Open the template.
slides.body: *aluxartandframes.shop* → The Gear Equalizer. Tap *Book this look*.

slides.title: 2. Crop to 4:5, then upload.
slides.body: Do the crop *first*. A photo of another shape gets cropped to fit, and you lose part of your frame.

slides.title: 3. Type *197*.
slides.body: One look comes up and it is already chosen. That is the whole search — no scrolling through 197 tiles.

slides.title: 4. Leave the background alone.
slides.body: It should say *keeping yours*. The look is about the light on you, not the room — the club, the restaurant, the hallway all stay exactly where you were.

slides.title: The whole thing.
items: Leave the background as it is

slides.title: One photo. ₦1,000.
slides.body: No subscription and no app to install. Upload up to 10 at once if you have a whole night to fix — you pay per photo.

slides.title: Look 197.
slides.body: Send me the one that came out too dark and I'll tell you if it will work.
